## Content overview

- Tuesday --- [Slurm batch jobs](./w7_1_slurm.qmd)
- Thursday --- [Batch jobs: in practice and workflow management](./w7_2_protocol.qmd)

- Get a better understanding of the purpose and mechanics of "runner scripts".
- What challenges you can run into when creating analysis pipelines
  with regular Bash scripts, including runner scripts.
- What "workflow management systems" like Snakemake and Nextflow are,
  and what the advantages of formal pipelines written with these are.
- What the nf-core initiative is, and how you can run one of their pipelines at OSC.
